newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sanluis gold, silver sales up through Q3.
newsitem.headline: Sanluis gold, silver sales up through Q3.

text.p: The mining division of Mexico's Corporacion Industrial Sanluis had gold and silver sales of $41 million in the first three quarters of this year, up 13 percent in dollar terms from the same period in 1995, the company said.

"The mining division of Sanluis achieved sales of gold and silver of $41 million or 327 million pesos...an increase of 13 percent in dollar terms and equaling sales in pesos from the first nine months of 1995," the company said in a statement to investors.
Sanluis said it sold 57,000 troy ounces of gold and 4.3 million ounces of silver through Q3. Those volumes were up 29 percent for gold and 21 percent for silver over the same period last year.
The cost of gold production of $183 per ounce remained unchanged over the last year, the company said.
